business.description: The Company is engaged in Trading of Food Products mainly, in milk. The Company collects Raw Material and supplies it to the big dairy for finished products.

products.name: Milk
products.note: Trading of food products mainly in milk

outlook.statement: The management expects higher turnover in the Current Year. Besides it also proposes to develop the Cattle farm in near future with improved technology. The management forces improved performance in near future on account of this action.

risks: External factors are based on market competition and availability of cheaper material
Internal material related to nature of product which is perishable in nature
Potential risk of fraud and corruption due to rapid growth and geographical spread of operations
Accounting software audit trail feature disabled at application level for maintenance of books of accounts and relevant transactions

auditor.name: VSSB & ASSOCIATES
qualifications_or_emphasis: The remarks made by the Auditors in their Report have been suitably dealt with in the schedules and notes and therefore, do not call for any further clarification.
Scheme of Reduction of Capital approved by shareholders at EGM on 27/03/2025, subject to NCLT approval.
Management fails to provide procedure adopted to maintain proper record of Audit Trail as required by Rule 3(1) of Companies (Accounts) Rules, 2014 effective 01.04.2023.
Balances of Trade Receivables, Trade Payables, Loans including deposits and advances are subject to confirmation from and reconciliation with relevant parties as on balance sheet date.
The Company is required to have an adequate internal audit system u/s 138 of the Companies Act, However, it does not have the same established for the year.
The Company did not have an internal audit system for the period under audit so we are unable to obtain internal audit report. Hence, we haven't considered internal audit report.
Accounting software has audit trail feature but disabled at application level for maintenance of books of accounts and relevant transactions
Global standard ERP not enabled with audit trail log at database layer to log direct transactional changes due to present design of ERP
auditor.opinion: Unmodified opinion; the Standalone Financial Statements give a true and fair view in conformity with Ind AS of the state of affairs as at 31st March 2026, and its Loss, total comprehensive income, cash flows and changes in equity for the year ended on that date.
key_audit_matters: Determination of transaction price for measurement of revenue according to Ind AS 115; revenue recognition on satisfaction of performance obligation and transfer of control pertaining to goods.
